name: 11420 · S Ozone Park, NY
findings: ZIP 11420 (S Ozone Park) has 88 nonprofit organizations. 23 of them (26%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 17 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11420 (S Ozone Park) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
100% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 11420 (S Ozone Park) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 73% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 23 organizations here; 98% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
